description: Buffered leave-one-out (training points within the variogram range excluded)
reason: With a 160 km range, removing every training point within range of a test point removes most of Europe's training data for each point; the 200 km block run tests the same question (amendment A18)
Not available for scikit-learn forests or histogram boosting; the unweighted run covers the class-weighting question (amendment A18)

description: Leave-one-country-out with class priors re-estimated by EM (Saerens et al., 2002)
reason: Specified in the protocol but not built; found missing in the audit of 22 November 2026 (amendment A20). H3b is reported with the held-out country's own class mix

description: Missing predictors (mainly clay and silt) imputed iteratively inside the training folds instead of complete cases
reason: Specified in the protocol (Data cleaning, missing values) but not built; found missing in the read-through of 22 November 2026 (amendment A21). Complete cases drop 8.6% of points overall: 83% in LU, 43% in HR, about 30% in IE and the UK
